title: Ecommerce Checkout
summary: Convert cart intent into paid order with minimal friction, clear totals, and recoverable payment failures.

strategies.name: Single-page checkout
strategies.tradeoffs: Fewer clicks; longer page and harder mobile focus.
strategies.when: Simple catalogs with one ship-to and few upsells.

strategies.name: Multi-step stepper checkout
strategies.tradeoffs: Clear progress; more abandonment between steps.
strategies.when: Complex shipping, gifts, or B2B purchase orders.

strategies.name: Guest checkout default
strategies.tradeoffs: Higher conversion; weaker CRM identity capture.
strategies.when: First-purchase heavy retail and low-frequency buys.

strategies.name: Express wallets above fold
strategies.tradeoffs: Huge mobile lift; can skip email capture for marketing.
strategies.when: Mobile-dominant traffic with Apple/Google Pay support.

neverDo: Surprise fees only on the final confirm screen
Hide return policy until after purchase
Use tiny unchecked marketing opt-ins by default
evidenceNotes: Compiled from captured app journeys + curated designer wisdom.
